paragraphs: R' Yehuda bar Sisin. See the entry R' Yehuda bar Signa.[^1]

notes.text: Sisin (סיסין) and Signa (סיגנא) remain different supplied patronymics. Both abbreviated titles remain R'; the notice provides only a pointer.
